model.shadow.review.challenge-witness-ex: The stacked v0.4 witness must rebuild exactly before the v0.5 anchor gate evaluates it.

model.shadow.review.challenge-anchor-pol: The v0.5 leaf strictly validates and self-digests one caller-presented anchor policy, without authenticating its origin.

model.shadow.review.challenge-anchor-exp: The caller-presented expected digest must exactly equal the validated anchor policy digest.

model.shadow.review.challenge-anchor-det: The v0.5 leaf verifies canonical 64-byte detached Ed25519 signatures over anchor-specific authorization payloads.

model.shadow.review.challenge-anchor-thr: All presented authorizations must verify and satisfy a one-through-ten threshold with distinct key fingerprints and steward digests.

model.shadow.review.challenge-anchor-sig: Valid signatures prove possession of keys allowed by the exact anchor policy, not host authority, human participation, or real-world identity.

model.shadow.review.challenge-anchor-exa: Each authorization binds the exact anchor and expected digest, v0.4 witness, witness policy, checkpoint, ledger manifest, and entries digest.

model.shadow.review.challenge-anchor-rec: Receipts retain digested authorization/key identifiers, key fingerprints, and steward digests; they omit raw keys, signatures, state paths, identity strings, private context, and model output.

model.shadow.review.challenge-anchor-wit: The full anchor-policy, authorization, witness-policy, checkpoint, and witness chain rebuilds exactly before use.

model.shadow.review.challenge-anchored-c: An anchored witness receipt must rebuild before its exact v0.4 witness can drive the stacked continuity comparison.
Fresh Node processes verify the serialized anchored package and audit exact, extended, missing, invalid, absent, and identity-drift synthetic ledger states without writing the ledger.

model.shadow.review.challenge-anchored-r: A missing challenge is detected relative to the exact anchored checkpoint; detection remains distinct from prevention or restoration.

model.shadow.review.challenge-anchor-fix: A valid replacement v0.4 witness policy and witness cannot reuse the original anchor authorizations while the expected anchor digest remains fixed.

model.shadow.review.challenge-anchor-joi: A counterexample proves that replacing both caller-presented anchor and expected digest with new valid signatures creates a distinct valid chain, so host trust remains false.

model.shadow.review.challenge-anchor-aut: Receipts grant no host, identity, human, provider, execution, evaluation, adoption, installation, promotion, merge, Foundation, or CANON authority.

model.shadow.review.challenge-anchor-hos: Both anchor and expected digest are explicitly caller-presented and unauthenticated; no Mike- or host-promoted pin was supplied.

model.shadow.review.challenge-anchor-ext: The selftest serializes a synthetic package outside the ledger namespace, but no independent store, receiver, or retention authority is proven.

model.shadow.review.challenge-anchor-mon: The anchor epoch is self-declared and caller-owned; signatures do not prevent withholding, deletion, rollback, or joint replacement.

model.shadow.review.challenge-anchor-ste: Synthetic key possession does not authenticate the steward digest, declared human kind, real person, or host identity.

model.shadow.review.challenge-anchor-tim: Validity-window checks use caller timestamps; no external trusted time receipt was supplied.

model.shadow.review.challenge-global-sin: Comparison remains bound to one presented chain and ledger identity and does not establish global challenge uniqueness.

model.shadow.challenger.human-review.act: Only synthetic keys and generated fixtures were used; no real person reviewed a current anchor, checkpoint, or plan.

model.shadow.challenger.shadow-execution: No model provider or shadow experiment was invoked.
model.shadow.challenger.evaluation.actua: No current baseline/challenger evaluation was executed or supplied.
model.shadow.challenger.human-benefit.he: No voluntary held-out human outcome was observed.
